rule: required = max(measured deployment gas x live base fee x 5, 0.02 ETH floor)
ruling: decision.md 2026-09-10, phase 5 Base fork rehearsal review
implementation: src/deployerGate.ts, called by scripts/deploy-network.ts before any write

liveCases.case: the gate passes a funded deployer at a realistic Base base fee (0.05 gwei; the 0.02 ETH floor governs)
liveCases.message: ASSERT deployer 0xa24b363e7C334aE0BFAD8BBd4C305354C74af8a9 holds 0.03 ETH, at or above the 0.02 ETH: 24778573 gas (measured over 22 transactions, evidence/phase5/base-fork/measurements.json) x 0.05 gwei live base fee (latest block 51000003) x 5 = 0.00619464325 ETH, floor 0.02 ETH governs

liveCases.case: the same deployer with the same balance is refused once the base fee is high (0.5 gwei)
liveCases.message: REFUSED: deployer 0xa24b363e7C334aE0BFAD8BBd4C305354C74af8a9 holds 0.03 ETH, below the 0.0619464325 ETH: 24778573 gas (measured over 22 transactions, evidence/phase5/base-fork/measurements.json) x 0.5 gwei live base fee (latest block 51000004) x 5 = 0.0619464325 ETH, floor 0.02 ETH
